concerns.text: Task T013 (Data Ingestion) is marked as unchecked `[ ]` and the Analyze Report flags it as 'rejected'. This leaves the critical input artifact `data/raw/social_media.csv` missing. Without this file, downstream tasks T014b, T014c, T015, T021, and T030 cannot execute, blocking the entire pipeline for US1 and US2. A valid task to ingest the dataset must be present and actionable.

Tasks T014b (Non-English filtering) and T014c (Gibberish filtering) are marked `[ ]` and flagged as 'rejected' by the Analyze Report. These are required to satisfy Spec US1-AC-002. Their absence means the pipeline cannot produce the `data/processed/preprocessed_text.csv` required by T015 (Anxiety Scoring), violating the coverage of US1-AC-002.

Task T006a (Dataset Validation) depends on the 'finalized' schema from T008c, but T008c depends on T006a's output. This circular dependency (also flagged by Analyze) means neither task can be executed to satisfy Spec SC-004 (Runtime Threshold) or US1-AC-001 (Dataset verification). The task list fails to provide a linear path to validate the dataset before ingestion.

Task T015 (Anxiety Model Inference) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T014c (Gibberish filtering) which is also `[ ]`/rejected. Consequently, there is no actionable task to implement the core US1 functionality (assigning anxiety scores) as required by Spec US1-AC-001 and US1-AC-003.

Task T021 (Proxy Extraction) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T013 (Data Ingestion) which is `[ ]`/rejected. This breaks the coverage for Spec US2-AC-007 (No text content access) and US2-AC-005/006, as the input data `data/raw/social_media.csv` is never produced.

Task T030 (Merge & Save) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T017 (US1 Output) and T026 (US2 Output). Since the upstream tasks for US1 and US2 are blocked/rejected, T030 cannot be executed, leaving Spec US3 (Statistical Correlation) without the necessary merged data to satisfy US3-AC-010.
